misc: Famous for being an ambassador for the AimPoint method for putting.
biography: Timo, representing Keimola Golf, stands as a fixture in the annals of the Hector Trophée. As the 2026 edition approaches, it will mark his ninth occasion competing in this prestigious event, a testament to his enduring involvement and consistent dedication to the tournament.

Throughout his extensive participation, Timo has showcased his considerable talent, particularly in the pair format. He has been a pivotal member of the winning duos that have lifted the coveted Hector Trophée on three separate occasions, a remarkable achievement that underscores his aptitude for team play and strategic collaboration on the course. While individual glory, in the form of the Victor Trophy, has yet to materialize, his impact on the team competition is undeniable.

Timo is widely recognized for his profound understanding and advocacy of the AimPoint method for putting. This scientific approach to reading greens is a hallmark of his game, reflecting a player who values precision and analytical execution above all. His composed temperament and meticulous green-reading skills have undoubtedly been instrumental in navigating the pressure-filled moments that define the Hector Trophée, contributing significantly to his team's past successes.

As Timo prepares for his ninth appearance, the golf community will undoubtedly watch with keen interest. His sustained competitive drive, coupled with his proven track record in the team competition, positions him as a player who consistently performs at a high level, always striving for excellence in every aspect of his game.
